title: Dad Found The Beat

intro: my dad has to find the beat
youtube_title: Find the beat challenge, but my dad keeps clapping on a beat that isn't here 🕺
description:
I do the dance, Dad finds the beat. Easy. Except Dad claps on five, Grandma has three accounts just to roast him, and the speaker has a secret.

tiktok_caption: find the beat challenge but my dad lives on five 🕺 #findthebeat #findthebeatchallenge #dancechallenge #dadsoftiktok #fyp

lines.text: Okay. Find the beat challenge. I start the dance, Dad has to find the beat.
I have never lost a beat in my life. I just never looked for one.
He looked once. At his wedding. He found a chair.
That chair was on beat, Mom.
Speaker, play the song.
Good evening. I am the speaker. Playing your song.
There it is.
Here we go! Bounce, bounce, shoulder, spin.
Hold on. I am listening with my whole body.
He's listening like a man who heard his name at the airport.
Found it! Is this it? This feels like it.
Dad, you are clapping on a beat that is not in this room.
Okay. Coaching time. Count with me. One, two, three, four.
Five.
There is no five, Dad.
There's always a five. That's where I live.
Just copy me. Step left, step right, little hop.
Left. Right. And now a little stop.
That's not a hop. You just stopped.
I hopped on the inside.
He dances like he's parallel parking a boat.
Okay, I posted the practice take. Let's read the comments.
Read them. I can take it. I raised you.
Someone wrote, your dad found the beat and returned it without a receipt.
That's fair. I return everything.
Another one says, sir, the beat is right in front of you.
That one's from me.
I have three accounts. One is just for your dancing.
Alright. No more mister nice dad. I'm stretching.
Speaker. One more time.
Playing your song. Again.
There it is.
Wait. Did anybody else hear that? There was a little wait.
Dad, focus. Bounce, bounce, shoulder, spin.
Bounce, bounce, shoulder, spin!
You did it two seconds before me!
Then you're late.
I am never late! I have been doing this dance since August!
Move over, baby. Let a professional find the beat.
Bounce, bounce, shoulder, and spin.
Grandma, you were also two seconds early!
Early is on time. Your grandfather taught me that at the roller rink.
Okay. I have something to confess.
You're a speaker. What could you possibly confess?
I have a two second delay. I have always had a two second delay.
So I was on beat.
Perfectly on beat. Everyone else was dancing to me.
I learned the whole dance two seconds late?
Since August. I was too proud to say anything.
That explains the wedding. The conga line went straight into the cake.
In my defense, the cake was also late.
I found the beat! I have always had the beat! Put that in the comments!
Fine. One last take. Speaker, play it. Everybody, wait two seconds.
I've waited forty five years. Two more seconds is nothing.
Playing your song.
There it is.
Bounce, bounce, shoulder, spin!
Look at us. A whole family, finally on the beat.
Beat.
